comments.value: it has been abysmal watching innocent users fall through the floor against their will. only reason i was able to avoid such was a built in flight system to the world i was in
Happened while i was at fbt heaven too this is a really serious issue that needs to be dealt with
This has been happening before and after UnU update. Everyone experienced this only in SDK3 worlds, it's hard to tell if SDK2 worlds can also be affected.
This is a thing? Thankfully I have never experienced it, however I hope this gets fixed ASAP.

one thing to note is that it seems to be tied to the malicious client user actually remaining within the instance, but not always
it seems to stop after i kick whoever started it, however some people still remain falling infinitely, but most users regain collision with the world after the malicious user is either kicked or leaves the instance
unsure if this has any correlation, but its been common enough of an occurrence for me to make this conclusion
@{5dcae10f2fb049260da562f6|full_name}: sdk2 worlds are affected too, quest and desktop mode
I have seen multiple people independently say this is related to modified clients spawning portals.

@{58c6cbcffd04b1785f747b6c|full_name}: spawning portals? I'm not entirely sure how thats related, i've directly seen firsthand a client user spawn in, walk forward for a moment, and then everyone begins falling through the world repeatedly, until i kick the client user
if this has something to do with portals then that makes this even weirder of a phenomenon

@{5f87880e170ea9177ab2fb47|full_name}: More precisely, they are suggesting that the _attempt_ of spawning portals with bad properties causes it. Such as spawning them at an impossible location. Or attempting to spawn many of them at once.

@{58c6cbcffd04b1785f747b6c|full_name}: i guess that would make sense, since a VRC_Portal can be instantiated on all clients, and has a collider component, so it could possibly cause some form of "overflow" and causes other colliders on other gameobjects to effectively cease functioning until the portals are removed, (which happens when i kick the client user) ... interesting
@{5f87880e170ea9177ab2fb47|full_name}: guys just download such clients, decompile them and look at what they do if you really want to know what is being sent. Dont launch them though
Its even gotten worse, they are now spam teleporting people to spawn
i think there is another bug with the world when i join it puts me in a black box and gives me the stalker avatar
@{60a94d9d59f5ab023a79a038|full_name}: yeah i get that aswell i dont know why i was only in there once for maybe 5 minutes and i got kicked and now when i try join im in a box aswell
@{5f2dc3d9b923f7086bb0a2b5|full_name}: if it was that easy we'd be doing that, it's a whitelisted client, i know that much

that is not a bug, this is a ban feature in the world, you were both banned for using malicious modified clients in order to remove the collisions from the world and force teleport people to specific locations, which has since been patched
appeal to be unbanned here
https://forms.gle/NczTruSMMoDdMNcGA
@{5f87880e170ea9177ab2fb47|full_name}: lul
Same has been happening in the pug as of late.
@{58c6cbcffd04b1785f747b6c|full_name}: checking the game log will tell whats actually going on though
@{5f87880e170ea9177ab2fb47|full_name}: Can you share the world ban system? Would love to have it for my world.

details: A modified client user was able to directly disable the collisions of all gameobjects within my world, causing all users in the instance to fall through the floor repeatedly, this has been an ongoing issue for months now, i have received numerous reports from both my staff team, and my community members about this occurence and have seen it happen firsthand. please fix, as this is ruining the experience of multiple users of my worlds the exact moment someone with the modified client joins.
title: [Security] Collisions can be disabled by Modified Client for remote clients
